name: Bakunyuu Tsuma Tsumagoi Sumireko ~Ureta Bunny Girl to Hiretsu na Otoko-tachi~
original_name: 爆乳妻 嬬恋菫子 ～熟れたバニーガールと卑劣な男たち～
source:
"Wait! All you... just... just violate me. ONLY ME!" 

Sumire had started staffing at the diner, at her husband's recommendation. 
The food was great and the cheerful atmosphere ensured a steady throng of customers. 
It was provocative that the waitresses dressed as bunny girls, but Sumire was okay. 

It all came crashing down That Day. 

The restaurant was secretly pimping out its waitresses for prostitution. 
Sumire and her coworkers were suddenly serving customers a different way. 

When she realized the trap all the girls were pulled into 
she tried to protect the others by drawing attention. It was so brutal, though... so brutal... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120662.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“等等！你们……只……只侵犯我一个人！”

在丈夫建议下，堇开始在一家餐厅工作。食物美味，欢乐氛围保证了稳定客流。女服务员都打扮成兔女郎，虽然有些挑逗，但堇并不介意。

然而，一切在“那天”崩塌。

餐厅暗中把女服务员卖给客人卖淫。
堇与同事突然开始以另一种方式“服务”客人。

意识到所有女孩都落入陷阱后，她试图通过吸引注意力来保护其他人。可这一切太残酷了……太残酷了……
